summary: The PR introduces a specific handling for the 'extension' argument when it includes 'I', which may not cover all edge cases and could lead to behavioral regressions.

issues.description: The PR does not handle all possible cases for the 'extension' argument, particularly when it includes multiple elements besides 'I'.
The change might introduce behavioral regressions for other types of extensions or when the extension list contains multiple elements.
The PR lacks additional tests to verify the behavior with different types of extensions and multiple elements in the extension list.
